title: InterviewQuestionBank file
description: One JSON file under assets/content/psy2/<family>/questions/. Holds the original PSY2 interview questions of one theme (docs/content/psy2-spec.md §4.1). Dart: InterviewQuestionBank, InterviewQuestion.

InterviewTheme.description: One of the seven reported PSY2 interview themes (spec §4.1).

InterviewQuestion.description: One original interview question, never a leaked/copied real question (author-content skill, legal note).

guidance.description: What a strong answer covers (STAR-shaped: situation, action, result/reasoning) without mandating the acronym; never a scripted answer. May be shared across every question of a theme.

modelAnswerSkeleton.description: A structural skeleton (e.g. "Situation -> action -> result -> what I'd repeat/change"), not a written-out answer.
